definition: Pubic hair removal; the shaving of pubic hair, mandated in Islam as a fitra hygiene practice.
notes: One of five fitra practices per hadith; Islamic jurisprudence sets a recommended maximum interval of 40 days; the religious framing reduces secular shame relative to Western discourse; literally 'shaving the pubic region' (العانة = pubic area).

definition: Female genital mutilation; the partial or total removal of external female genitalia for cultural or purported religious reasons.
notes: Literally 'female circumcision'; the neutral-seeming name functions as a sanitizing euphemism in pro-FGM discourse; human-rights Arabic prefers 'تشويه الأعضاء التناسلية الأنثوية'; prevalence high in Egypt, Somalia, Sudan, parts of Yemen; practice predates Islam and is not mandated by any of the four major Sunni schools.

definition: Sadism; sexual gratification derived from inflicting pain, humiliation, or suffering on a partner.
notes: Arabized calque of the European psychological term, derived from the Marquis de Sade; known primarily in educated and psychology-literate circles; also used non-sexually in political and social commentary to mean generalized cruelty.

definition: Masochism; sexual gratification derived from experiencing pain, humiliation, or subjugation.
notes: Arabized transliteration named after Leopold von Sacher-Masoch; less commonly known than سادية among general MSA speakers; primarily encountered in psychological literature and internet discourse; sometimes spelled ماسوشية in informal contexts.

definition: Sadomasochism; a practice or person combining both sadistic and masochistic elements in sexual activity.
notes: Compound of the two Arabized transliterations; found primarily in psychology texts and journalism; the acronym SM is not in common MSA use; recognition limited to educated and internet-connected speakers.

definition: Physical restraint; in sexual/kink contexts, the erotic practice of restraining a partner with ropes, cuffs, or other means.
notes: General MSA word with broad non-sexual applications (legal confinement, restricted access, document registration); the BDSM meaning is secondary and understood only in kink-aware circles; crude score reflects erotic connotation rather than the base word, which is clinically neutral.

definition: Bonds, fetters, or physical restraints; in a sexual context, the binding of a partner for erotic purposes.
notes: Classical and Quranic Arabic word for fetters or chains (root و ث ق, 'to bind firmly'); literary register gives it an archaic flavor compared to the more prosaic تقييد; occasionally used in Arabic-language erotica or BDSM writing for its elevated register; recognition lower than تقييد due to literary/archaic character.

definition: Sexual deviance or perversion; any behavior or orientation judged to deviate from religiously and socially sanctioned norms, deployed to condemn homosexuality, premarital sex, BDSM, and other non-normative sexuality.
notes: Literally 'sexual deviation'; commonly deployed in MSA media, religious fatwas, and legal discourse as a condemnation term; mapped to paraphilia as the nearest clinical concept but انحراف جنسي is inherently pejorative and morally loaded, unlike the neutral DSM term.

definition: Sexual deviance or abnormality; the dominant MSA legal and religious term for homosexuality, carrying inherent condemnation and used to criminalize LGBTQ identity across Arab jurisdictions.
notes: Literally 'sexual abnormality' (شذوذ = deviation/aberration); the primary official Arabic term used against LGBTQ people in legislation, media, and religious discourse; criminalized under شذوذ جنسي statutes in many Arab countries; broader than 'sodomite' since it encompasses all non-normative sexuality, not only anal sex; mapped to sodomite as the closest registry concept combining legal/religious condemnation.

definition: Sexual slavery or sexual submission; used in BDSM contexts for consensual total-power-exchange, and in general MSA discourse for coerced sex slavery or trafficking.
notes: Ambiguous between consensual BDSM submission and literal coerced sex slavery; kink-section context maps to bdsm_submission; in Arabic news and legal discourse عبودية جنسية far more commonly refers to trafficking or ISIS-documented enslavement of Yazidi women; the BDSM reading is a Western import known to internet-connected demographics.

definition: Dominance and submission; the BDSM dynamic in which one partner exercises consensual authority over the other.
notes: Calque of English 'dominance and submission'; used in Arabic-language BDSM and psychology writing; هيمنة (dominance/hegemony) is mainstream MSA while خضوع (submission/compliance) carries Quranic resonance; the pairing in an explicitly sexual-kink context is a modern Western import.

definition: A fetish; sexual arousal triggered by a specific object, body part, or scenario not typically considered inherently sexual.
notes: Direct phonetic transliteration of English 'fetish'; native alternatives such as 'هوس جنسي' or 'شهوة محددة' appear in clinical texts but فيتيش dominates online discourse; recognition concentrated among younger, internet-exposed demographics.

definition: Exhibitionist desire; sexual arousal derived from exposing oneself or performing sexually in front of others.
notes: Descriptive compound (شهوة = lust/desire, استعراض = display/showing off) rather than a loanword; the registry concept names the person while this phrase names the desire, hence approximate; alternative phrasing 'شهوة التعري' also used; the concept is less commonly discussed in Arabic psychological and social discourse than in Western contexts.
